content:
The hunting graph lets you search with predefined scenarios. These scenarios are prebuilt
advanced hunting queries that help you answer specific and common questions for specific use
cases.
To start hunting with a predefined scenario, on a new hunting graph page, select Search with
Predefined scenarios. A side panel appears where you can then perform the following steps:
1. Select a scenario and enter the required inputs
2. Apply filters on the graph
3. Render the graph

